blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. confirmed that dismissed patrolman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. had previously served as a security detail for former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco. “He (Gracioso) had been detailed as a security or staff of former speaker Velasco,” Nartatez said during an ambush interview prior to a turnover ceremony on Monday. Vice President Sara Duterte earlier denied knowing Gracioso Jr., who was reportedly a former security officer of Velasco and allegedly delivered cash to her and members of her family.
